_comment: Response body for GET /api/site/overview, the endpoint app/page.tsx reads on mount.
These are operating figures for Switchyard, which is a FICTIONAL product — they are
demo content, not measurements of anything. They are committed rather than computed
so the capture is reproducible: screenshot.png is captured against exactly this
payload, and a recapture only moves pixels when the UI actually changed.
Deliberately no figure about frontend-design-pro itself. The previous version of this
page served the pack's own counts from here, two of them drifted out of step with
metadata.json, and the page shipped a wrong constraint count and a wrong gate count
on a screenshot in the repo README. A fictional product cannot drift.
Values are irregular on purpose: the anti-slop wall bans round data, because 1,000
deploys and 50% faster are what a generated page says when nobody measured anything.
No entry carries a "source" key, because none of these is copied from anywhere. If
you ever add one that is — "source": "metadata.json · stats.release_gates" — Gate 11
reads that key and fails the build when the value drifts from the stat it names. That
check exists because this file once served the pack's own counts and went stale.
Shape is fixed by PlatformMetric, exported from components/MetricsStrip.tsx.
